server.service.type: ClusterIP exposes the API and UI inside the cluster. NodePort also exposes them on a port on each node.
server.replicas: Number of Pods serving the Argo CD API and web UI.
repoServer.replicas: Number of Pods that fetch repositories and generate Kubernetes manifests.
server.resources: CPU and memory requests and limits for the Argo CD API and web UI server.
repoServer.resources: CPU and memory requests and limits for the repository server.
server.metrics.enabled: Create a Service for scraping Argo CD API server metrics.
